Introduction

Kim Nayun is a South Korean singer. She is a member of the girl group MOMOLAND.

She earned third place in the reality survival show "Finding Momoland", earning her a spot in the group. She debuted as a member of MOMOLAND on November 10, 2016 with their first mini album Welcome to Momoland. On February 14,2023, MOMOLAND announced their offical disbandment, however on April 10, 2025, MOMOLAND announced their return, now under Inyeon Entertainment (the same agency as 1THE9's former member Lee "ONLEE" Seung-hwan).
